mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent economic downturn indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO drop > 2% MoM does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3%, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent accommodative policy effects.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in one month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 300,000 does not correlate with subsequent strong economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and retail sales (RSAFS) also decline by more than 5% YoY, it signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS declines > 5% YoY
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or the combination of HOUST and RSAFS declines does not correlate with subsequent weakening consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or FEDFUNDS < 2% does not correlate with subsequent positive market performance.
